## create

Create Context Endpoint. `POST /context-endpoints`

Create a context endpoint. The response contains the signing secret ONCE.

timeout_ms is clamped to 200-3000, ttl_seconds to 0-3600. The URL must be https and must not point to a private network.

```php
$result = $sendseven->contextEndpoints()->create(name: 'name', url: 'url');
```

- Scopes: `settings:update`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$name` | `string` | yes | Display name |
| `$url` | `string` | yes | HTTPS URL that receives the signed POST |
| `$timeoutMs` | `?int` | no | Request timeout in ms, clamped to 200..3000 (default 1500) |
| `$ttlSeconds` | `?int` | no | Cache lifetime per contact in seconds, clamped to 0..3600 (default 300, 0 = no cache) |
| `$responseMap` | `array<string, mixed>\|null` | no | Up to 30 entries {"out_key": {"path": "a.b.c", "label": "Plan"}}. Only mapped values reach the agent. |
| `$isEnabled` | `?bool` | no | Disabled endpoints are never called |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `ContextEndpointWithSecret`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/Context%20Endpoints/create_context_endpoint_api_v1_context_endpoints_post)

Test Context Endpoint. `POST /context-endpoints/{endpoint_id}/test`
